evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce a physics-consistent benchmark for contact-rich human-robot interaction, instantiated in robot-assisted bathing.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Conventional task-level evaluation asks whether a robot policy completes a specified action, but can miss failures that emerge only during physical human contact.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: The benchmark combines a deformable, passively responding human, physics-aware scores alongside task-level success, and a frozen vision-only / scorer-only evaluation protocol.
